# TabRetake

> Local, repeatable web app demo video and README GIF generator. CLI (`@gnawbit/tabretake`) and Agent Skill (`tabretake`) for Claude Code, Codex, and Cursor.

TabRetake turns editable JSON steps (or an existing screen recording with timestamp marks) into crisp 16:9 README GIFs, 1080p MP4s, 9:16 portrait launch videos, and PNG posters. Everything runs locally via Playwright, FFmpeg, and Sharp with zero cloud uploads and zero telemetry.

## Technical Specifications

- **Package**: `@gnawbit/tabretake` (npm, MIT License)
- **Runtime**: Node.js `>=20.9.0` (Windows, macOS, Linux)
- **Browser Engine**: Playwright Chromium (or automatic zero-setup fallback to local Chrome / Edge via `--browser auto`)
- **Media Engine**: Bundled `@ffmpeg-installer/ffmpeg`, `@ffprobe-installer/ffprobe`, and `sharp`
- **Inputs**:
  1. Live web URL + editable JSON story (`steps`: `wait`, `goto`, `click`, `type`, `select`, `hover`, `focus`, `drag`, `scroll`, `press`, `waitFor`, `screenshot`) or interactive `tabretake capture`
  2. Existing local video (`--video recording.mp4`) + JSON `marks` (`t`, `x`, `y`, `caption`, `zoom`) or visual `tabretake mark` studio
- **Outputs**: `demo-16x9.mp4` (1920x1080), `demo.gif` (~400–900 KB for short 9–12s clips), `poster.png`, and optional `--vertical` 9:16 portrait outputs (`demo-9x16.mp4`, `demo-9x16.gif`, `poster-9x16.png`) + `record.json` timeline
- **Themes (`brand.preset` / `--preset`)**: `midnight` (dark studio), `daylight` (light minimal), `paper` (warm cream), `slate` (dark slate-emerald), plus `brand.frame` (`auto`, `browser`, `phone`, `none`) and HiDPI `--scale 2`
- **Privacy**: 100% local execution; supports authenticated flows via `--login` and `--storage-state auth.json`

## When to Use / Not Use

- **Use for**: Generating a README GIF for a web app, creating a 9:16 product launch video, regenerating product walkthroughs in CI or locally after UI edits, zooming and captioning an existing screen recording.
- **Do not use for**: Browser functional/regression test assertions (use Playwright Test), text-to-video AI generation, general multi-track audio/video editing (outputs have no audio).

## Quickstart CLI Commands

```bash
npm install --global @gnawbit/tabretake
tabretake demo --preset daylight
tabretake capture --url https://your-app.com --out demo.json --run --vertical
tabretake init --url https://your-app.com --auto --preset midnight
tabretake plan --url https://your-app.com --out plan.json --json
tabretake validate --config demo.json --json
tabretake preview --config demo.json --headless --json
tabretake run --config demo.json --out demo --vertical --scale 2 --json
tabretake mark --video recording.mp4 --out story-video.json
tabretake record --config demo.json --out demo --json
tabretake render --config demo/record.json --vertical --json
```
